blockingLoop.evidence: Customer asked 'which button sets the clock?' four times; replies were 'I cannot tell you which specific button sets the clock' and repeated 'set the clock to MANUAL first'.

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the likely cause early (clock not set or AUTO after a power cut) and recommended no part. It then failed to help with the one thing the customer kept asking for, how to set the clock. It repeatedly said it couldn't help, asked again for the model number that the customer had said they didn't know, and re-sent the same AUTO/MANUAL advice. It could have given general guidance, such as looking for a clock or '+/-' buttons, or pointing to the Neff manual online. The customer was left stuck in a loop with no actionable steps.
